jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(A) inventory: Danville School District, a town school district in the Caledonia Central Supervisory Union (member town: Danville).

sources.note: Danville School District board members page (official): five directors -- Clayton Cargill (Chair, term expires 2027), David Towle (Vice-Chair, 2027), Tim Sanborn (2027), Eric Hewitt (2028), Kay Freedy (2029). The March 3, 2026 annual meeting minutes elect Freedy (3-year seat) and Sanborn and Cargill (the two section 423(b) one-year seats) by voice vote; Towle and Hewitt are continuous incumbents on the section 423 stagger whose current-term election minutes (March 2024 / March 2025) were not fetched -- no appointment document exists for either in any fetched record. The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b)).
